column1: # The Arduino default for a 4MB board spends 1.5MB on a SPIFFS partition the
# dock has never used - it has no filesystem at all
# keeps lives in NVS. That left two 1.25MB app slots
# Assistant WebSocket client took the image to 98.2% of one
# nvs and otadata keep the offsets and sizes the default table gave them
# a dock reflashed onto this layout keeps its pairing
# MQTT and Home Assistant settings. Only the app slots grow and SPIFFS goes.
# NOTE: changing the table needs one USB flash. A dock still running the old
# layout cannot receive this over the air
column2: because its slots are the smaller
